title: Intero Biosystems offers lab-grown human intestines for drug testing
excerpt: Startup Intero Biosystems provides lab-grown mini human intestines for pharmaceutical testing as regulators push for alternatives to animal trials.
body_html:
Intero Biosystems is offering pharmaceutical companies lab-grown human intestines as an alternative to traditional animal testing. The startup provides these miniature human organoids as regulatory bodies increasingly encourage the industry to reduce its reliance on animal subjects during drug development.

Alongside this commercial push, the company is actively working to scale up its production capabilities. Furthermore, Intero Biosystems plans to expand its organoid technology to potentially cover other applications, providing drugmakers with human-relevant testing platforms.
